title: SREV-074 driver API current-process sentinel width contract

rejected_shape.description: Arbitrary 64-bit values that only match after ULONG truncation

contracts: API arguments are captured into ULONG64 slots before driver handlers read them
ZwCurrentProcess and NtCurrentProcess are special HANDLE sentinel values for the current process
HANDLE and pointer-like values must be compared with pointer-precision types rather than ULONG truncation
IS_ARG_CURRENT_PROCESS accepts the native pointer-width -1 sentinel
IS_ARG_CURRENT_PROCESS accepts the zero-extended 32-bit 0xffffffff WOW64 sentinel
IS_ARG_CURRENT_PROCESS must reject arbitrary 64-bit values that only match after truncation to ULONG
